content.comment_body: Good morning, I have two questions: - What is the memory capacity of [product_name]? - What is the memory size of the memory card for [product_name]? Thanks for your support.

Dear [user_name], Please review the FAQ here: [url] According to the manual: The [product_name] memory card with [article_no] and the [product_name] memory/battery card with [article_no] offer 32 Kbytes of memory, which is four times larger than the previous [product_name] memory card with [article_no]. Additionally: • Up to 200 program blocks can now be included in a circuit program. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about the memory specifications of a [company_name] [product_name] module and its corresponding memory card. The response referenced official documentation, providing details about the increased memory capacity and program block limit associated with newer versions of the [product_name] memory card. However, the base module's memory was not directly addressed.
